caption: The drawing features a mantel clock with a wooden frame in a rich brown color. The clock has a pointed, cathedral-like top with two finials, one on each side. The body consists of vertical columns on either side, and the wood is depicted with detailed grain texture. The clock face is circular and set at the top section of the frame, with black Roman numerals marking the hours and two black hands indicating the time. Below the clock face, there is a rectangular glass panel adorned with a white and gray decorative design, including a crowned lion, a unicorn, and floral elements. The background of the drawing is a light beige color, and there are some light stains or marks present on the paper. At the bottom right, the name “F. MILLER” is inscribed, and a small horizontal scale with numbers is drawn below the clock.
title: Clock
